opening.argument: The material is structured as an operational walkthrough of seller-support access, beginning with the stated purpose of explaining how to contact support for an online marketplace and identifying email, phone, and chat as available channels. It then supplies concrete procedures: users are told they can “directly call or chat and ask” for eBay assistance, while another support process requires them to “select your issue select the reason.” The displayed Amazon support page and eBay contact options reinforce that the focus is on navigating legitimate support workflows. Although a separate Meesho promotion and affiliate links appear, the material supplied here does not establish deceptive terms, destination behavior, or any connection between those links and the support tutorial.
